name: Eventee Public API
description:
Welcome to Eventee public API documentation. You will find here detailed information about all available calls with specific request and response structure. You can easily implement it in your application.

## Authentication

You need to generate your unique API token on https://admin.eventee.co/ in 'Settings -> Features' section. You will use this token to authenticate to Eventee public API.

You need to send Authorization header in every request. Authorization type is Bearer so you need to send your generated token in this format: 

`Authorization: Bearer <token>`

## Recommended Headers

- `Accept: application/json` - If you want to see possible errors in JSON format
- `Content-Type: application/json` - If content of your request is in JSON format

## Base URL
All endpoints are prefixed with `/public/v1`
